item.title: CONTRIBUTOR'S VIEW - John Tures: Five Questions To Ask Ourselves About The War With Iran
item.description: John Tures poses five urgent questions about the U.S. conflict with Iran, from war aims and allies to Congress’s role, post-Khamenei Iran and America’s long-term goals.

item.title: Springwood recognizes Distinguished Alumni, Service to School winners
item.description: Springwood School’s Legacy Gala at the Burrow Warehouse honored Distinguished Alumni Dr. Garrett Aikens and Noelle Wilkinson and Service to the School recipients Amber and Toby Sides.

item.title: CONTRIBUTOR'S VIEW - L. Michelle Moore: A New Pledge to Bring Down Power Bills
item.description: Tech giants back Trump’s Ratepayer Protection Pledge, promising to fund data-center power upgrades—now states must turn that commitment into lower household energy bills.

item.title: Wellstar cuts ribbon on new Urgent Care and Primary Care center
item.description: Wellstar has opened a combined Urgent Care and Primary Care center on Vernon Road in LaGrange, aiming to expand access and divert nonemergency cases from the ER.
